Product Manager

Adventure Works Ops is a fictional logistics software company. This is an IC product role on an existing operations platform. It is not a founding PM role.

Requirements:
- Own roadmap for an existing B2B operations platform
- Work with engineering, support, and account management
- Use metrics to decide what ships next

Preferred:
- Salesforce workflow familiarity
- Experience in fulfillment or onboarding automation

Responsibilities:
- Cut operational waste without claiming revenue ownership
- Keep the backlog honest under resource constraints
